title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_now}
description: Phase 8 §8.1 / §8.3 — operator forces an immediate nightly-shape pg_dump + restore-verify cycle outside the cron window. Consumer: maint.backup.v1 (lands in §8.3). `target` is 'pg' for the standard PG dump, or a specific db name when multiple DBs exist (v1: 'pg' only is recognised; other values rejected at consumer side).

target.description: v1: 'pg' (the only recognised value). Future DBs widen the consumer-side allow-list, not the schema.

skip_prune.description: When true, the consumer runs dump + verify but skips the §8.3 TTL prune phase. Useful for emergency snapshots; default false.
